sections.title: How to Use AI Character Motion Swap

steps.title: Choose a Model
steps.body: Pick the model built for your goal: Character Motion Control, Replace the Character in a Video, or Apply Video Motion to Photo.

steps.title: Upload a Motion Reference Video
steps.body: Add a source video with the movement you want to apply: a gesture, a performance or a dance.

steps.title: Upload Your Photo
steps.body: Upload the photo you want to animate: a portrait, a character illustration or any image with a clear subject.

steps.title: Generate and Save
steps.body: Click Generate, preview your result and download it in HD, or find it saved in My Gallery.

sections.title: Turn Any Photo Into Motion: 3 Ways to Use AI Character Motion Swap
Make Any Photo Move
sections.body: Upload a reference video, such as a dance clip, a walking shot or a simple gesture, and pair it with your photo. AI Character Motion Swap applies that motion to your image and builds a video from it. A strong fit for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, where dynamic motion holds attention.

items.question: What do I need to start?
items.answer: One photo with a clear subject and one reference video with the motion you want.

items.question: Which model should I pick?
items.answer: Character Motion Control moves a photo. Replace the Character in a Video swaps you into a clip. Apply Video Motion to Photo animates illustrated or AI-generated characters.

items.question: Does the result keep my face and style?
items.answer: Yes. Faces, proportions and art style carry through from the original image.

items.question: What kind of reference video works best?
items.answer: A clip with one clear subject and visible full-body or upper-body motion, such as a gesture, performance or dance.

items.question: Can I animate an illustration or AI-generated character?
items.answer: Yes. Use Apply Video Motion to Photo.

items.question: Where is my result saved?
items.answer: You can download it in HD, and it is saved in My Gallery.

items.question: Do I need animation or 3D skills?
items.answer: No. The tool needs only a photo and a reference video.

items.question: Can I use it for social videos?
items.answer: Yes. Results fit TikTok, Reels, Shorts, memes and reaction videos.
